sci-repo-y10-aran-2015-chem2-general-mc-.coverage: Original assessment questions with source figures. Written parts remain in the bank with marks and parent context. Review-required items excluded from automatic battles.

questions.prompt: Select the incorrect statement about catalysts.
options: Catalysts increase the amount of energy needed to convert reactants into products.
Catalysts make it easier for reactant molecules to collide and form products.
Catalysts are not used up during reactions.
questions.explanation: A:catalysts provide an alternative reaction pathway with lower activation energy,not higher.

questions.prompt: Choose the missing words for this statement. If a solid  ______________  is divided into smaller pieces, more of the solid is exposed to the liquid reactant and the rate of reaction is  _______________.
questions.explanation: A:reactant,increased;smaller pieces expose more surface area.

questions.prompt: A cation is an atom that has a:
questions.explanation: B:a cation has positive net charge. Polyatomic cations also exist,so a cation is not necessarily a single atom.

questions.prompt: The chemical formula for boron oxide is:

options: a solution of a substance dissolved in an acid.
a solution of a substance dissolved in water.
a solution of two different chemicals.

questions.prompt: The general name for the chemicals that take part in a chemical reaction is:
“Matter cannot be created or destroyed during a chemical reaction” is known as:
options: the law of conversation of mass.
the law of creation of mass.
the law of conservation of mass
the law of conservation of energy.

questions.prompt: Choose the equation that is not balanced.
questions.explanation: A:pentane combustion is unbalanced as printed. Correct complete combustion:C₅H₁₂+8O₂→5CO₂+6H₂O. The source HCL in optionB is a case typo for HCl.
